== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-tantiveiv-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Tantive IV]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Tantive IV (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “May be deployed even without presence or Force icons.” is added at the start; “aboard” is dropped; “May be deployed to any system (even without presence or Force icons).” is dropped. These are the same words as [[Tantive IV (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “•Tantive IV” and a white italic “E”. The slip also changes the type line to “CAPITAL: CORELLIAN CORVETTE” and the stat box “ARMOR 4” to “MANEUVER 4”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
